entries.originalText: Lord, all that is in the heaven and in the earth is Thine.(1) I desire to offer myself up unto thee as a freewill offering, and to continue Thine for ever.
entries.modernizedText: Lord, all that is in heaven and on earth is Yours.(1) I desire to offer myself to You as a freewill offering and to remain Yours forever.

entries.originalText: Lord, in the uprightness of mine heart I willingly offer(2) myself to Thee to-day to be Thy servant for ever, in humble submission and for a sacrifice of perpetual praise.
entries.modernizedText: Lord, in the uprightness of my heart I willingly offer(2) myself to You today to be Your servant forever, in humble submission and as a sacrifice of perpetual praise.

entries.originalText: Receive me with this holy Communion of Thy precious Body, which I celebrate before Thee this day in the presence of the Angels invisibly surrounding, that it may be for the salvation of me and of all Thy people.
entries.modernizedText: Receive me with this holy Communion of Your precious Body, which I celebrate before You this day in the presence of the Angels invisibly surrounding us, so that it may be for my salvation and that of all Your people.

entries.originalText: Lord, I lay before Thee at this celebration all my sins and offences which I have committed before Thee and Thy holy Angels, from the day whereon I was first able to sin even unto this hour; that Thou mayest consume and burn them every one with the fire of Thy charity, and mayest do away all the stains of my sins, and cleanse my conscience from all offence, and restore me to Thy favour which by sinning I have lost, fully forgiving me all, and mercifully admitting me to the kiss of peace.
entries.modernizedText: Lord, at this celebration I lay before You all my sins and offenses which I have committed before You and Your holy Angels, from the day I was first able to sin until this hour, so that You may consume and burn every one of them with the fire of Your charity, remove all the stains of my sins, cleanse my conscience from all offense, and restore me to Your favor which I have lost by sinning, fully forgiving me all and mercifully admitting me to the kiss of peace.

entries.originalText: What can I do concerning my sins, save humbly to confess and lament them and unceasingly to beseech Thy propitiation?
entries.modernizedText: What can I do concerning my sins except humbly confess and lament them and unceasingly ask for Your propitiation?

entries.originalText: I beseech Thee, be propitious unto me and hear me, when I stand before Thee, O my God.
entries.modernizedText: I beg You, be gracious to me and hear me when I stand before You, O my God.

entries.originalText: All my sins displease me grievously: I will never more commit them; but I grieve for them and will grieve so long as I live, steadfastly purposing to repent me truly, and to make restitution as far as I can.
entries.modernizedText: All my sins displease me grievously; I will never commit them again, but I grieve for them and will grieve as long as I live, steadfastly resolving to repent truly and make restitution as far as I can.

entries.originalText: Forgive, O God, forgive me my sins for Thy holy Name’s sake; save my soul, which Thou hast redeemed with Thy precious blood.
entries.modernizedText: Forgive, O God, forgive me my sins for Your holy Name’s sake; save my soul, which You have redeemed with Your precious blood.

entries.originalText: Behold I commit myself to Thy mercy, I resign myself to Thy hands.
entries.modernizedText: See, I entrust myself to Your mercy; I surrender myself into Your hands.

entries.originalText: Deal with me according to Thy loving-kindness, not according to my wickedness and iniquity.
entries.modernizedText: Deal with me according to Your loving-kindness, not according to my wickedness and iniquity.

entries.originalText: I offer also unto Thee all my goodness, though it is exceedingly little and imperfect, that Thou mayest mend and sanctify it, that Thou mayest make it well pleasing and acceptable in Thy sight, and ever draw it on towards perfection; and furthermore bring me safely, slothful and useless poor creature that I am, to a happy and blessed end.
entries.modernizedText: I also offer You all my goodness, though it is exceedingly little and imperfect, so that You may mend and sanctify it, make it pleasing and acceptable in Your sight, and always draw it toward perfection; and furthermore bring me safely, slothful and useless poor creature that I am, to a happy and blessed end.

entries.originalText: Moreover I offer unto Thee all pious desires of the devout, necessities of parents, friends, brothers, sisters, and all who are dear to me, and of those who have done good to me, or to others for Thy love; and those who have desired and besought my prayers for themselves and all belonging to them; that all may feel themselves assisted by Thy grace, enriched by consolation, protected from dangers, freed from pains; and that being delivered from all evils they may joyfully give Thee exceeding thanks.
entries.modernizedText: Moreover I offer You all the devout desires of the faithful, the needs of parents, friends, brothers, sisters, and all who are dear to me, and of those who have done good to me or to others for Your love; and those who have desired and asked for my prayers for themselves and all belonging to them: that all may feel themselves helped by Your grace, enriched by consolation, protected from dangers, and freed from pains; and that, delivered from all evils, they may joyfully give You abundant thanks.

entries.originalText: I offer also to Thee prayers and Sacramental intercessions for those specially who have injured me in aught, made me sad, or spoken evil concerning me, or have caused me any loss or displeasure; for all those also whom I have at any time made sad, disturbed, burdened, and scandalized, by words or deeds, knowingly or ignorantly; that to all of us alike, Thou mayest equally pardon our sins and mutual offences.
entries.modernizedText: I also offer You prayers and Sacramental intercessions especially for those who have injured me in anything, made me sad, spoken evil of me, or caused me any loss or displeasure; and also for all those whom I have ever made sad, disturbed, burdened, or scandalized by words or deeds, knowingly or unknowingly: that You may equally pardon the sins and mutual offenses of us all.

entries.originalText: Take away, O Lord, from our hearts all suspicion, indignation, anger, and contention, and whatsoever is able to injure charity and diminish brotherly love.
entries.modernizedText: Take away, O Lord, from our hearts all suspicion, indignation, anger, and contention, and whatever can injure charity and diminish brotherly love.

entries.originalText: Have mercy, have mercy, Lord, on those who entreat Thy mercy; give grace to the needy; and make us such that we may be worthy to enjoy Thy grace, and go forward to the life eternal.
entries.modernizedText: Have mercy, have mercy, Lord, on those who ask for Your mercy; give grace to the needy, and make us such that we may be worthy to enjoy Your grace and go forward to eternal life.
